install:
set -euo pipefail
pip install pyyaml pytest
# Pin agent-swarm for SWARM_ROOT. Public HTTPS, full commit SHA, no credentials.
# The runtime stays outside this repo. Substrate wiring stays off.
SWARM_SHA=92b964c72cf18c9af09120f9c980ec85a70a198b
SWARM_URL=https://github.com/swcstudiospace/agent-swarm.git
SWARM_ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/agent-swarm"
export SWARM_ROOT
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$SWARM_ROOT")"
if [ ! -d "$SWARM_ROOT/.git" ]; then
  git -c init.defaultBranch=main init "$SWARM_ROOT"
  git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" remote add origin "$SWARM_URL"
else
  git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" remote set-url origin "$SWARM_URL"
fi
if git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD && [ "$(git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SWARM_SHA" ]; then
  :
else
  git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" fetch --depth 1 origin "$SWARM_SHA"
  git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
fi
test "$(git -C "$SWARM_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SWARM_SHA"
# The install process does not keep exported variables for a later shell.
# Login shells read /etc/profile.d; interactive bash reads ~/.bashrc.
python3 - "$HOME/.bashrc" "$SWARM_ROOT" <<'PY'
import pathlib, shlex, sys
path, root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
marker = "# agent-swarm SWARM_ROOT (programming-desk)"
line = "export SWARM_ROOT=" + shlex.quote(root)
rows = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if path.exists() else []
out = []
i = 0
while i < len(rows):
    if rows[i] == marker:
        i += 1
        if i < len(rows) and rows[i].startswith("export SWARM_ROOT="):
            i += 1
        continue
    out.append(rows[i])
    i += 1
out.append(marker)
out.append(line)
path.write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
printf 'export SWARM_ROOT=%q\n' "$SWARM_ROOT" | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/swarm-root.sh >/dev/null
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/swarm-root.sh
